mapper.select: SELECT c.*,a.username actor_username,COALESCE(NULLIF(a.nickname,''),a.username) actor_name, u.username member_username,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username) member_name FROM afv_project_membership_command c JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=c.actor_user_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY c.revision DESC
SELECT id,project_id,revision FROM afv_project_membership_command WHERE published=FALSE ORDER BY create_time,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
